references.text: Luke's description of Joseph of Arimathea taking Jesus' body down, wrapping it in linen and laying it in a tomb cut out of the rock
John's description of Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus taking Jesus' body, binding it in linen cloths with spices, according to Jewish burial custom
The Pentateuch's description of Moses being buried by God can be seen as a precursor to the honorable treatment of Jesus' body
